subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should this Discord media resolver report get live Discord reproduction before any repair work is queued?
rationale: Source inspection proves the resolver error and Discord handoff path, but the current code also has generic media-ref support, so choosing a fix without live proof risks changing the wrong boundary.

options.title: Run Live Discord Proof
options.body: Exercise a real Discord DM image on current main and capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool success or failure before repair.

options.title: Park As Needs Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open with the current labels until the reporter or maintainer can provide runtime logs or a live reproduction.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Media Retention Work
options.body: Treat it as partial overlap with the open WhatsApp second-read issue if maintainers decide both reports share one session media-retention root cause.

recommendation.title: Run Live Discord Proof
recommendation.body: Exercise a real Discord DM image on current main and capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool success or failure before repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant recent merged work is the generic inbound media reference fix, which is the boundary this issue is testing.
